Anthony Edwards scored the Timberwolves' first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 23 times in 68 starts, or 34% of the games they started. Julius Randle was next with 20. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
